description.value: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]] is reduced to 0 hit points by force, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage that isn't a critical hit, it doesn't die. Instead, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] becomes &reference[Incapacitated] (such that any &reference[attackrolls]{attack roll} is automatically a critical hit), as its skull glows with dormant energy. Crushing the skull with an action or a subsequent critical hit kills the [[lookup @name lowercase]]. Otherwise, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] returns to 20 hit points and reanimates after 1 minute. The [[lookup @name lowercase]] will then give pursuit or set an ambush, whichever is more likely to work to kill its attacker.
